scope: Read-only review of source-derived visibility presets, the ten added pruned GLB scenes per car, and canonical asset index validation. Shared parent tools/manifests were not edited.

findings.claim: Visibility output matches explicit source-derived local node states, not every live game frame or shader/draw result.
findings.evidence: Generator derives constructor geometry-presence values, applies explicit wheel/light/exhaust setters, compares mutable node bits to race95, and exporter clones only locally visible nodes. Validator checks source node identity, offsets, geometry, translation, names, mutability, child pruning, and mesh references.
findings.impact: Do not describe these GLB scene presets as full game-render equivalence.

findings.claim: The GLB does not store the global wheel override input as a machine-readable scene property.
findings.evidence: Preset contract describes helper `param6` and global override behavior, but scene extras only include `visibilityPreset`, `sourceTree`, and status. Cloned nodes encode selected local wheel visibility bits without an animation/controller that executes the helper.
findings.impact: Describe output as an explicit local node-state preset, not executable animation or full source-state replay.

findings.claim: The manifest schema/status/limits and per-car ownership verifier gaps identified in the prior review are closed in the current pinned verifier.
findings.evidence: Current verifier checks exact index and manifest schema/status/fidelity/limits declarations, derives complete expected records per car from producer receipts, and runs rehashed declaration mutations plus cross-car original-model swap as negative controls. Current `python3 tools/verify_recovered_asset_index.py` passes 35 cars and 2579 assets.
findings.impact: Current index integrity validation covers the documented declarations and producer-to-manifest per-car record association. It still does not test in-game rendering equivalence.

jev_review.receipt_note: Raw typed result captured in this note: low-confidence rubric outputs; agent performed direct source/code and adversarial-control inspection.

jev_verify_crosswalk.disposition: Evidence passed to Jev was too abbreviated/misaligned to establish two crosswalk claims. Treat that result as a negative/needs-review disposition, not positive proof; the artifact and deterministic joins remain source evidence.

limitations: Updated source hashes are pinned in inputs; the independent review describes source-derived visibility states, not all live frames.
The index verifier validates producer records and output bytes; it does not validate final in-game shader/draw equivalence.
A checker passing is not proof that all runtime or transformed texture paths are fully reconstructed.
